data: El documental narra el proceso creativo de Blanca Portillo para encarnar al personaje de María de Nazareth en la obra de teatro "Testamento de María" escrita por Colm Tóibín y dirigida por Agustí Villaronga. (MARIA CONVERSES follows the actress Blanca Portillo (Palm Award to the best actress in Cannes Film Festival for Almodovar's film 'Volver') on her creative process as she prepares to incarnate Maria of Nazareth in the play Mary's Testament" by Colm Toibin and under the direction of Agustin Villaronga.)

El documental narra el proceso creativo de Blanca Portillo para encarnar al personaje de María de Nazareth en la obra de teatro "Testamento de María" escrita por Colm Tóibín y dirigida por Agustí Villaronga.

MARIA CONVERSES follows the actress Blanca Portillo (Palm Award to the best actress in Cannes Film Festival for Almodovar's film 'Volver') on her creative process as she prepares to incarnate Maria of Nazareth in the play Mary's Testament" by Colm Toibin and under the direction of Agustin Villaronga.
